name: COSMOS
summary:
COSMOS — A light and sound journey into the universe.

Step into a poetic and immersive virtual reality experience created by Mirage Makers. After receiving a strange signal from outer space, you will be taken into the cosmos.

- Immersive experience with interactions.
- Talented Voice-Over actors.
- A 100% original poetic journey.

Made by Mirage Makers, a french studio building immersive experience in Europe.
